title: Vite dev proxy /api -> localhost:8000 with changeOrigin; dev-only exposure if server bound publicly
description: vite.config.js:8-13 proxies every /api request to http://localhost:8000 with changeOrigin:true. The dev server listens on default host; if anyone deploys or exposes `vite dev`/`vite preview` (e.g., on a cloud host without a reverse proxy), the proxy becomes an open relay to the backend with Origin spoofing via changeOrigin, and the backend CORS (localhost:3000/5173) would consider the traffic same-origin-compatible. Low likelihood in practice (dev tooling), but no guard prevents it - the repo has no deployment config that would exercise the production path.
impact: If dev server is publicly reachable, an open forwarding proxy to the backend and possible misconfig escalation; otherwise informational.
mitigation: Bind the Vite dev server to 127.0.0.1 (server.host='127.0.0.1') and document that only built frontend/dist behind a proper reverse proxy may be exposed.
